column1: # Scale-out home seats — roster table (read by tools/home_army_scale.sh and
# `make army-scale-status`). The ORIGINAL FOUR seats (Shadowfel, Igris, Tusk,
# Beru) are deliberately NOT here: they keep their own hand-written Makefile
# targets and lifecycle. The quest-QA seat (Kaisel / shadow9) is not here
# either — different runtime root, different lifecycle.
#   character  solo-leveling shadow-soldier name (AGENTS.md naming rule),
#              single capitalized word, <= 12 chars (client name rule).
#   account    realmd account; password is the same string (shadowN/shadowN
#              convention shared with shadow1..shadow4). shadow9 is SKIPPED —
#              it belongs to the quest-QA seat.
#   class      undead-legal class: warrior | rogue | priest | mage | warlock.
#              Race is always undead; the client rolls the character on first
#              login (docs/warlock-seat.md), so this column IS the class
# Classes were rolled at random over the undead-legal five (3 of each).
